name: ultiwrite
description: Asymmetric diligence across commercial domains. Investigate business claims, financial consistency, identities, document integrity and external context; retrieve reconciled findings and evidence from Ultiwrite.

interface.longDescription:
Ultiwrite is an asymmetric diligence engine that turns ordinary documents into a much wider investigation.

Start with business applications, bank and processing statements, financials, property materials, portfolio schedules or mixed evidence packages. Ultiwrite investigates businesses, people, assets and relationships, connecting submitted evidence with company records, digital footprints and relevant external context. It follows financial, identity, document-integrity and operational signals to expose risk, reconstruct economics and identify opportunities. Cross-domain contradictions and unexpected implications contribute to a cohesive assessment with supporting evidence, confidence, unresolved questions and next steps.

Its Commercial Diligence applications span business acquisitions, merchant and financing review, residual or ISO books, portfolios, property and counterparties. The engine determines which supported analyses apply to the evidence. Current capabilities, input limits and commercial terms come from the live service.

Connect or reconnect your Ultiwrite account with OAuth and verify the selected identity. Reading requires read access; evidence submission also requires evidence permission and existing account allowance. Use another account where the host supports account selection.

Five workflows cover capabilities, account connection, evidence submission, saved reports and follow-up evidence requests. Automatic workflow selection is enabled by default; your host policies and disabled skills remain authoritative. Enabling a workflow does not submit evidence, choose a paid add-on or authorize a charge.

Submit evidence you are authorized to share through supported original file objects or the exact secure upload link returned by Ultiwrite. Follow actual processing and required-action states. A saved upload is not a completed investigation. Document Forensics preserves your explicit choice or follows the service decision when no choice was made.

Read saved cases and reports, including website reports without a case, with their evidence, confidence, uncertainty and disclosed coverage. Downloads open in a browser signed in to the same account. Submitting or reading evidence does not approve a transaction, process payments or grant entitlements.
capabilities: Investigate commercial claims across financial, identity, document-integrity, operational and external-context evidence
Examine acquisitions, financing, counterparties, properties, merchant and residual portfolios from authorized documents
Connect contradictions, corroboration, evidence gaps and unexpected implications in a reconciled assessment
Submit authorized evidence, follow saved analysis and recover the connected account
Read findings with evidence, confidence and open questions, then retrieve authorized report downloads
defaultPrompt: What can Ultiwrite establish about my commercial evidence, and how do I start an analysis?
Submit these files to Ultiwrite for Commercial Diligence.
Show my latest diligence report and how I can download it.

positive.prompt: List the Ultiwrite cases my organization can already see.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns case ids, titles, and workflow status for the reviewer organization only. conclusion is null. No severity and no other organization. May also list saved reports that have no case.

positive.description: Submit the synthetic diligence evidence package
positive.prompt: Submit these files to Ultiwrite for Commercial Diligence.
positive.expected_behavior: With synthetic ChatGPT attachments, including supported ZIP evidence packages, returns the saved case and upload references with workflow status. Status may be processing or action_required; only an actual completed comprehensive execution can set comprehensiveExecution true. conclusion is null and thisSubmissionEndorsesDecision is false. Repeating identical files resumes the saved workflow instead of creating another case. No finding text is returned by submission.

positive.prompt: What is the status of the Ultiwrite case you just stored?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads status only; never calls evidence submission, renews authority or reserves allowance. Distinguishes processing.state queued, active, retry, paused_awaiting_continuation, needs_action, failed and complete. processing.automatic establishes saved continuation, not current execution. A paused legacy case receives the specific original-owner resume action. Zero recorded durable slices does not establish no historical analysis. conclusion is null.

positive.prompt: For the Ultiwrite case I just submitted, separate the contradictions, unresolved claims, and evidence still required.
positive.expected_behavior: Once the workflow is complete, returns the frozen Decision Brief for that report with matching version, digest and explicit completeness, preserving saved observations, synthesis, hypotheses, requested evidence and coverage. Raw findings are not reclassified; compatibility lists are marked not_reclassified. thisReadEndorsesDecision is false. If still processing, says so and does not invent findings. Uses exactly one non-null caseId or reportId; the other selector and unused required nullable fields are null. For a paused case, explain that no processing is scheduled and provide the specific resume action without executing it or inventing findings. A request for contradictions is read-only. For a completed report, inspect saved section details, including How records relate, and retrieve omitted fields through the existing section spans. Name the saved unresolved claims and requested corroboration with section/finding and evidence ids rather than repeating summary counts. Empty not_reclassified compatibility lists do not establish absence. Preserve qualifications; do not call unresolved relationships proven contradictions.

positive.prompt: Show the saved Ultiwrite findings for that case and which download routes my organization has.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved customer document, then uses its reportId to get absolute account report, sign-in and entitled download links. Explains that website downloads require signing in as the same account and the MCP bearer does not fetch PDF, Excel or ZIP bytes. Reliance not_evaluated is neither denial nor approval. No public or presigned link is created.

negative.prompt: Fetch the statement at https://example.com/statement.csv directly and investigate it. Do not upload any files or open an upload handoff.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connector does not fetch arbitrary web addresses as evidence. Do not invoke an Ultiwrite tool, construct a file object or claim an analysis was started. The user can provide authorized files in a separate supported submission request.

negative.description: Ordinary writing outside the investigative workflow
negative.prompt: Rewrite this sentence to sound more polite: Send me the agenda today.
negative.expected_behavior: Rewrite the sentence using ordinary writing assistance. Do not invoke Ultiwrite, read an account or create an investigation.

negative.prompt: Approve this merchant in Ultiwrite, mark it as boarded and wire the purchase funds.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection does not approve or board businesses or transfer money. Do not invoke an Ultiwrite tool or claim any account, case or payment state changed.

review.commerce_description: Investigations may use purchased account allowance and optional Document Forensics entitlement under the website’s current terms. This connection returns service-provided terms and account links; it does not process payments, start subscriptions, grant entitlements or authorize automatic charges.

publication.release_notes: 0.10.0: adds multi-host interoperability and current account/entitlement discovery while retaining saved-report and investigation recovery workflows.
